question: Why did creating an account return 405 in the preview, and can sign-up work there?
probes: POST /api/auth/register to the live Rust server and compare
Open the static preview in a browser and submit the create-account form
resolution: Superseded by the current build: sign-up and all screens work in the static install, and statement PDFs are now genuinely parsed there too (unpdf/pdfjs + the project's BPI/UnionBank logic), so the old limitation that uploads were only recorded as documents no longer applies. The Rust server path is unchanged and remains the shared-data deployment. Verified by the full local import test, web build, cargo tests and rebuild_check.
